text: Nor should the production of the desired object be sought. For, the earth-bearer (the earth) is not superior, nor is the long arm, because the practice is unobstructed due to wakefulness. Nor can it be said that the practice is thus for that which is the bearer of form, because of its being earth-like and so on, for such a form is not perceived in a mirror and the like. Moreover, just as the knowledge arising from the object conforms to its blueness, so if it also conforms to its inertness, then the object itself would be inert.
